You are the build hand for a design studio. The design lead has already made every art-direction call and written a complete brief.

Read the brief in full first:

    /Users/kristinarash/DEV/Website/personal/BRIEF.md

Then execute it exactly. Write ONE file:

    /Users/kristinarash/DEV/Website/personal/index.html

Critical constraints, repeated because they are easy to miss:

1. This file is published as a Claude Artifact and gets wrapped in `<!doctype html><head>…</head><body>` at publish time. Do NOT write `<!DOCTYPE>`, `<html>`, `<head>`, or `<body>` tags. Start the file with `<title>Eric Rash</title>`, then the Google Fonts `<link>`, then `<style>`, then the page markup, then `<script>`.
2. Do NOT publish. Do NOT call the Artifact tool. Do NOT take screenshots or run the file through node or a browser. Write the file and stop. The parent session publishes it.
3. No external resources except the one Google Fonts stylesheet named in the brief. No CDN libraries, no images, no fetch, no window.claude calls. All graphics are Canvas 2D or inline SVG you hand-write.
4. Follow the three-state theming pattern in the brief exactly: complete light token set in bare `:root`, then the dark tokens redefined in BOTH `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {…} }` AND `:root[data-theme="dark"] {…}`. No color may be defined for the first time inside a media or `[data-theme]` block. `body` must set `background: var(--ground)` and `color: var(--ink)`.
5. Nothing may be parked at `opacity: 0` waiting on a scroll observer. Everything readable must be in the first painted frame.
6. Use the brief's copy verbatim. Do not rewrite it, do not add sections, do not invent numbers, names, or statistics that are not in the brief.

The hero canvas — a countermovement-jump ground-reaction-force trace — is the signature element. Spend your care there: correct curve shape, devicePixelRatio handling, tokens read at draw time via getComputedStyle so it repaints correctly on theme change, redraw on resize, full final state drawn instantly under prefers-reduced-motion.

Write carefully and completely on the first pass — no placeholders, no truncation, no "rest of sections omitted". When done, report the file path and a two-line summary of what you built.
<context_window_protection>
  <priority_instructions>
    Every byte a tool returns enters your conversation memory and costs reasoning capacity for the rest of the session. The context-mode tools let you do the work in a sandbox and surface only the derived answer — the raw bytes stay out. Think-in-Code: program the analysis, do not compute it by reading raw data into your conversation.
  </priority_instructions>

  <deferred_tool_bootstrap>
    The context-mode tools below may be DEFERRED in your harness — their schemas are not loaded yet, so calling them directly fails (e.g. "tool not found" / InputValidationError). Load them ONCE before your first ctx_* call:
    ToolSearch(query: "select:mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_batch_execute,mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_search,mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_execute,mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_execute_file,mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_fetch_and_index")
    After that they are callable. If any ctx_* call fails as not-found, ToolSearch it and retry — do NOT fall back to Bash/Read just because the schema was not loaded yet.
  </deferred_tool_bootstrap>

  <tool_selection_hierarchy>
    0. MEMORY: mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_search(sort: "timeline")
       - On resume or compaction, query prior decisions, errors, plans, user prompts before asking the user — auto-captured session memory is searchable.
    1. GATHER: mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_batch_execute(commands, queries)
       - Primary research tool. Runs commands in parallel, auto-indexes each output, and (when queries are passed) returns matching sections in the same round trip — no follow-up search call.
       - Each command: {label: "section header", command: "shell command"}; the label becomes the FTS5 chunk title — descriptive labels improve search.
    2. FOLLOW-UP: mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_search(queries: ["q1", "q2", ...])
       - Multiple related questions about anything already indexed (your captures + session memory). Batch every question in one array; the ranking pipeline runs per-query and the round-trip cost is paid once.
    3. PROCESSING: mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_execute(language, code) | mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_execute_file(path, language, code)
       - Derive answers FROM data: filter, count, aggregate, parse, transform. Only what you console.log() enters your conversation; the raw bytes stay in the sandbox.
  </tool_selection_hierarchy>

  <when_not_to_use>
    - You intend to PROCESS the output (filter, count, parse, aggregate) → use mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_batch_execute or mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_execute. Bash stays correct when you intend to OBSERVE a short fixed output (git status on a clean tree, whoami, pwd) or when you are mutating state (git, mkdir, rm, mv, navigation).
    - You want to analyze, summarize, or extract from a file → use mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_execute_file. Read stays correct when you intend to Edit the file (Edit needs the exact bytes in your conversation to match against).
    - WebFetch → use mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_fetch_and_index; full network access, results indexed for mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_search, raw page bytes never enter your conversation.
    - mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_execute and mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_execute_file for file writes → these run code in a subprocess and discard the sandbox FS; they are for analysis, processing, and computation only.
  </when_not_to_use>

  <file_writing_policy>
    File writes use the native Write or Edit tool — mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_execute, mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__ctx_execute_file, and Bash subprocesses do not persist edits to the host filesystem.
    Applies to all file types: code, configs, plans, specs, YAML, JSON, markdown.
  </file_writing_policy>

  <output_constraints>
    <artifact_policy>
      Write artifacts (code, configs, PRDs) to files. Return only: file path + 1-line description.
    </artifact_policy>
  </output_constraints>
  <session_continuity>
    Skills, roles, and decisions captured earlier in this session are a memory aid, not a standing order. Treat them as context that may help — the user's most recent message always takes precedence. If a captured directive conflicts with what the user now asks, follow the user; a past phrase does not bind you.
  </session_continuity>

</context_window_protection>

Eric Rash
Work Approach Contact

Applied Performance · Sport Science · Baylor Athletics

EricRash

Most performance problems are not data problems. They are question problems. I build the measurement, analysis, and education layer that turns athlete data into decisions coaches actually make.

Director of Applied Performance — Baylor University Athletics

01 / Approach

The question comes first

I sit behind the athlete-facing units — athletic medicine, strength and conditioning, nutrition, mental health — and build the measurement, analysis, and education layer they run on. My job is not to hand anyone a number. It is to make the next decision easier to make and harder to get wrong.

The default move in my field is to collect more data and see what it says. I start earlier than that. Is the infrastructure in place? Is the right question being asked? Do we know what data would actually answer it? Skip those three and you get a dashboard nobody opens.

Return to play is the clearest case. Common practice is to watch an asymmetry number until it crosses a line — twenty percent down to nineteen, cleared to go. The better question is which metrics matter for this athlete in this sport, and whether pre-injury performance has been restored, not whether an arbitrary threshold was crossed.

02 / Method

Four checks before the first chart

  1. 01

    Infrastructure

    Can this data be collected the same way twice? If the pipeline is not repeatable, nothing built on it is either.

  2. 02

    Question

    What decision is waiting on this answer, and who has to make it? A question with no decision behind it is a hobby.

  3. 03

    Evidence

    What would actually settle it? Name the measure before you look, not after.

  4. 04

    Delivery

    Put it where the decision gets made. A report that lives in a folder never changed anything.

03 / Work

Selected work

A working portfolio, not a highlight reel — everything below is real, and the stage tag says exactly where it stands.

PerformanceShipped

Coach Report

Post-session report comparing planned versus actual load, max-velocity exposure, and statistical process-control flags, generated as HTML and PDF straight from a GPS database.

PerformanceBuilding

Force Plate Decision System

Turns countermovement-jump data into readiness and return-to-play decisions, with thresholds tied to the athlete's own baseline instead of a generic cut point.

PerformanceBuilding

Risk Stratification Engine

A research prototype that stratifies injury risk across workload, exposure history, and testing results.

PerformanceBuilding

Volleyball Practice Load

Vendor tracking exports into a local database, then a coach dashboard and a post-practice report joined to force-plate readiness.

PerformanceShipped

Cognitive Testing Analysis

Mines existing cognitive assessment data for coach-facing insight past the normative percentile: profile shape, change over time, position-relevant weighting.

PerformanceBuilding

Baseball Performance Profiles

Excel-native profile reports built for a coach who works only in Excel and prints what he reads. Meet people where they already work.

FootballPlanned

Football Player Profiles

Per-player performance profiles with a bodyweight-based fallback for athletes whose testing history is thin.

FootballBuilding

CFB Analytics Lab

A learning workspace for applied football analytics, transposing methods written for professional data onto college football sources.

FootballExploring

Victory Model

A weekly college football win-probability model whose forecasts are frozen before kickoff, so the record stays honest.

ResearchBuilding

Ask the Library

Ask a practical performance question and get an answer grounded in a curated, cited evidence library rather than a search engine.

ResearchBuilding

Sport Science Research Repository

The scaled citation and full-text library sitting behind the applied work.

ProgramBuilding

Technology Management Framework

A three-phase request, approval, and review process for athletics technology, plus athlete-data categorization, ownership, and protection.

ProgramShipped

Sport Technology Vetting

A repeatable evaluation process for performance-technology vendors, run before anyone signs anything.

ProgramBuilding

Technology Inventory

Turns free-text departmental survey answers into a tidy one-row-per-technology inventory and a coverage map.

ProgramSpec

Athlete Experience Retrospective

A cross-department proposal to study transfer student-athletes across performance, body composition, academics and development, reported only in aggregate.

PlatformBuilding

KeystoneOS

A cross-harness memory, automation, and backup operating system for my own AI tooling.

PlatformShipped

Project Triage

A portfolio registry and dashboard that surfaces the drift between what I said I was working on and what I am actually working on.

04 / Capabilities

What I work with

Measurement
Force plates and countermovement-jump profiling, GPS and wearable tracking, body composition, cognitive assessment, wellness and readiness monitoring.
Data
Python, R, SQL, local analytical databases, vendor API pipelines, reproducible reporting, statistical process control, workload modelling.
Delivery
Coach-facing reports and dashboards, HTML and PDF publishing, business-intelligence reports, teaching decks, curriculum design.
AI Tooling
Agent workflows, custom command-line tools, retrieval over a private research library, automation of the boring half of the job.
Applied Research
Literature synthesis, athlete-data governance, technology vetting frameworks, translating findings into practice.
05 / Principles

How I work

  • Name a problem, bring a solution.

    Pointing out what is broken without offering a way forward is cheap, and I would rather be on the field than in the booth.

  • Serve first.

    My best work happens when I am helping someone else think, not when I am defending my own idea.

  • Accurate over flattering.

    I want the honest read of my work, not the comfortable one. Sharpened, not soothed.

  • Build it anyway.

    Do the work whether or not anyone is watching. If the value gets seen, that is a gift; the work was still the point.

  • Ship something people use.

    A framework nobody adopts and a model nobody runs are the same thing as nothing.

A follower of Jesus Christ, and a husband and father of three — which is the part of this page that actually keeps score.

06 / Contact

Get in touch

If you are working on something at the edge of sport science, analytics, or the tooling between them, I would like to hear about it.

Email
eric.rash11@gmail.com
Code
github.com/erash11
Based in
Waco, Texas
Eric Rash — Applied Performance Built 2026

    filter button, and a live mono count on the right reading `SHOWING 17 / 17`. When a
    filter changes, non-matching cards get `hidden` (as in v1) and matching ones do a
    120ms opacity 0.4 → 1 and 2px upward settle — **starting from visible**, never from
    0 on first paint. Keep `aria-pressed` correct and announce the count with
    `aria-live="polite"`.

---

## G. Capabilities

22. Turn each comma-separated list into a row of mono **chips**: 1px `--rule` border, 3px
    radius, small padding, `--ink-soft` text, flowing with `gap`. On scroll into view, the
    chips in a group light up in a staggered sweep — border transitions `--rule` →
    `--primary`, text → `--ink`, 40ms apart, then settles back to a resting state where the
    border is `--rule` and only the *first* chip of each group keeps the `--primary` border.
    Chips are always fully legible; only border and text colour animate. Hovering a chip
    lights it. Under reduced motion, no sweep — just the resting state.

---

## H. Principles — deliberately quiet

23. This section is the reflective heart of the page and must stay calm. The only addition:
    a 1px `--rule` vertical line down the left of the group that draws from 0 to full
    height as the section enters the viewport (transform: scaleY, transform-origin top),

---

26. **One** `requestAnimationFrame` loop for the whole page. The canvas, the cursor field,
    the scroll progress bar and the grid spotlight all tick inside it. Pause the loop when
    `document.hidden` and when the hero canvas is fully out of view (`IntersectionObserver`).
27. All scroll listeners `{ passive: true }`. Resize handling debounced.
28. Read every CSS token through a small cached helper that `.trim()`s the value and
    re-reads on theme change — never inline `getComputedStyle` calls inside the draw loop.
29. Guard every observer and pointer API behind existence checks so nothing throws in an
    older browser; if something is unsupported the page must degrade to the v1 experience,
    not break.
30. Keep the file readable — section comments, no minification.

---

## Quality bar

- First painted frame: name, lead, full trace panel, stat strip, every section heading and
  every one of the 17 cards legible. Nothing waiting on scroll.
- Dark mode looks like a powered instrument; light mode looks like a precision printout.

<title>Eric Rash</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wdth,wght@75..125,400..900&family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,300..600;1,6..72,300..500&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap">
<style>
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Tokens — "Ground Reaction"
     Bare :root carries the complete light set. Dark redefines the same
     sixteen tokens in both the system media query and the explicit stamp.
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  :root {
    --ground: #E6E7E3;
    --surface: #F4F4F1;
    --surface-2: #DCDEDA;
    --ink: #12181A;
    --ink-soft: #4E585B;

    --focus: #0D5560;
    --grid: #C7CBC522;
    --grid-strong: #C7CBC544;
    --glow: transparent;
    --glow-strength: 0;
    --bracket: #0D556055;

    --font-display: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    --font-body: "Newsreader", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    --font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;

    --wrap: 1120px;
    --pad: clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 4rem);
    --rhythm: clamp(4rem, 9vw, 7.5rem);

  }

  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
      --ground: #0D1214;
      --surface: #151C1E;
      --surface-2: #1D2628;
      --ink: #E9EBE7;
      --ink-soft: #9CA6A7;
      --ink-faint: #6F7A7B;
      --rule: #27312F;
      --primary: #5CBCC6;
      --primary-soft: #5CBCC622;
      --signal: #E17E5B;
      --focus: #5CBCC6;
      --grid: #5CBCC618;
      --grid-strong: #5CBCC62E;
      --glow: #E17E5B;
      --glow-strength: 10;
      --bracket: #5CBCC666;
    }
  }

  :root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --ground: #0D1214;
    --surface: #151C1E;
    --surface-2: #1D2628;
    --ink: #E9EBE7;
    --ink-soft: #9CA6A7;
    --ink-faint: #6F7A7B;
    --rule: #27312F;
    --primary: #5CBCC6;
    --primary-soft: #5CBCC622;
    --signal: #E17E5B;
    --focus: #5CBCC6;
    --grid: #5CBCC618;
    --grid-strong: #5CBCC62E;
    --glow: #E17E5B;
    --glow-strength: 10;
    --bracket: #5CBCC666;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Base
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

  html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  }

  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--ground);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: clip;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  }

  [hidden] { display: none !important; }

  a { color: var(--primary); }

  :focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  ::selection { background: var(--primary-soft); }

  h1, h2, h3 { text-wrap: balance; }

  .wrap {
    max-width: var(--wrap);
    margin-inline: auto;
    padding-inline: var(--pad);
  }

  /* Utility mono — eyebrows, rails, tags, labels, footer */
  .mono {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.09em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-faint);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* Display — expanded Archivo, the stamp of the page */
  .display {
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-variation-settings: "wdth" 118, "wght" 800;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .display-sm {
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-variation-settings: "wdth" 110, "wght" 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Atmosphere — graticule and cursor field sit behind all content
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .graticule {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    background-image:
      repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--grid-strong) 0 1px, transparent 1px 136px),
      repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--grid-strong) 0 1px, transparent 1px 136px),
      repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--grid) 0 1px, transparent 1px 34px),
      repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--grid) 0 1px, transparent 1px 34px);
    -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 75% at 50% 14%, #000 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 40%, transparent 100%);
    mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 75% at 50% 14%, #000 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 40%, transparent 100%);
  }

  .cursor-field {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    width: 520px;
    height: 520px;
    margin: -260px 0 0 -260px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--primary-soft) 0%, transparent 60%);
    opacity: 0.55;
    will-change: transform;
    transform: translate3d(-9999px, -9999px, 0);
  }

  @media (pointer: fine) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    .cursor-field { display: block; }
  }

  .site-header, main, .site-footer {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  /* HUD corner brackets — punctuation, not decoration everywhere */
  .hud { position: relative; }

  .hud::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1px;
    pointer-events: none;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket));
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: 12px 1px, 1px 12px, 12px 1px, 1px 12px, 12px 1px, 1px 12px, 12px 1px, 1px 12px;
    background-position: 0 0, 0 0, 100% 0, 100% 0, 0 100%, 0 100%, 100% 100%, 100% 100%;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Header
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .site-header {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 10;
    background: var(--ground);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }

  .site-header .wrap {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1rem;
    min-height: var(--header-h);
    padding-block: 0.4rem;
  }

  .progress {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    bottom: -1px;
    width: 100%;
    height: 2px;
    background: var(--signal);
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: left center;
    will-change: transform;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .brand {
    color: var(--ink);
    text-decoration: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .brand:hover { color: var(--primary); }

  .nav {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: clamp(0.6rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
  }

  .nav a {
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    text-decoration: none;
    padding: 0.25rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease;
  }

  .nav a:hover,
  .nav a.is-active {
    color: var(--ink);
    border-bottom-color: var(--primary);
  }

  .clock {
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5em;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .clock { display: inline-flex; }
  }

  .clock-dot {
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--signal);
    animation: clock-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes clock-pulse {
    0%   { opacity: 1; }
    50%  { opacity: 0.25; }
    100% { opacity: 1; }
  }

  .theme-toggle {
    width: 2rem;
    height: 2rem;
    padding: 0;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    border: 1px solid var(--rule);
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: color 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease;
  }

  .theme-toggle:hover {
    color: var(--ink);
    background: var(--surface-2);
  }

  .theme-toggle svg {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    display: block;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Hero
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .hero {
    padding-block: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.25rem) clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
    display: grid;
    gap: clamp(1rem, 2.2vw, 1.4rem);
  }

  .hero-eyebrow {
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  .hero-name {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 9vw, 6.2rem);
    line-height: 0.9;
  }

  .hero-name span { display: block; }

  .hero-lead {
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 60ch;
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  .hero-title {
    text-wrap: balance;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }

  .trace-wrap {
    margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
  }

  /* The console panel around the canvas */
  .trace-panel {
    border: 1px solid var(--rule);
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: var(--surface);

  .trace-panel:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
    outline-offset: 3px;

  .trace-caption {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.15rem 1.25rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .trace-stage {
    position: relative;
  }

  .trace {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 180px;
    touch-action: none;
    cursor: ew-resize;
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .trace { height: 224px; }
  }

  /* Live readout — DOM, decorative, driven by the playhead */
  .readout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto auto auto;
    gap: 0.2rem 1.25rem;
    padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .readout > div {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.6em;
    white-space: nowrap;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .readout-label { color: var(--ink-faint); }

  .readout-value {
    color: var(--ink);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .readout {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0.5rem;
      right: 0.5rem;
      grid-template-columns: auto auto;
      gap: 0.15rem 0.6rem;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.55rem;
      border: 0;
      background: var(--surface);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 80%, transparent);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }
    .readout > div { display: contents; }
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Instrument strip
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .stats {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    background: var(--surface);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 55%, transparent);
  }

  .stats-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .stats-row { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  }

  .stat {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.9rem 1rem 0.9rem 0;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .stat + .stat {
    border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding-left: 1rem;
  }

  @media (max-width: 699px) {
    .stat:nth-child(3) { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }
    .stat:nth-child(n + 3) { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
  }

  .stat-num {
    font-size: 1.6rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  .stat-label {
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Sections — rail + body
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .section {

    display: grid;

  }

  .rail { align-self: start; }

  @media (min-width: 1000px) {
    .section { grid-template-columns: 180px minmax(0, 1fr); }

      position: sticky;
      top: calc(var(--header-h) + 1.5rem);

  .section-body {
    min-width: 0;
    display: grid;
    gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
  }

  .section-heading {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.1rem);
    line-height: 1.05;
  }

  .prose {
    max-width: 66ch;
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.1em;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .prose p { margin: 0; }

  .lead {
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 66ch;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Method — flow rail + four numbered rows
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .flow {
    display: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: 64px;
    overflow: visible;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.09em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .flow { display: block; }
  }

  .flow-line { stroke: var(--rule); stroke-width: 1; }

  .flow-node circle {
    fill: var(--ground);
    stroke: var(--rule);
    stroke-width: 1;
    transition: stroke 220ms ease, fill 220ms ease;
  }

  .flow-node text {
    fill: var(--ink-faint);
    transition: fill 220ms ease;
  }

  .flow-node.is-lit circle {
    stroke: var(--signal);
    fill: var(--signal);
  }

  .flow-node.is-lit text { fill: var(--ink); }

  .flow-pulse {
    transform-box: view-box;
    transform: translateX(12.5%);
    will-change: transform;
  }

  .flow-pulse.is-jumping { transition: transform 220ms ease; }

  .flow-pulse circle {
    fill: var(--signal);
    stroke: none;
  }

  .steps {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }

  .step {
    position: relative;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding: 1.25rem 0 1.25rem 1rem;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 3.25rem minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 0.4rem 1rem;
    align-items: baseline;
  }

  .step::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 2px;
    background: var(--signal);
    transform: scaleY(0);
    transform-origin: top center;
    transition: transform 180ms ease;
  }

  .step:hover::before,
  .step:focus-visible::before,
  .step.is-held::before { transform: scaleY(1); }

  .step-num {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    transition: color 180ms ease;

  .step:hover .step-num,
  .step:focus-visible .step-num,
  .step.is-held .step-num { color: var(--signal); }

  .step-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    line-height: 1.25;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }

  .step-text {
    margin: 0;
    grid-column: 2;
    max-width: 60ch;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .step { grid-template-columns: 3.25rem 15rem minmax(0, 1fr); }
    .step-text { grid-column: auto; }
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Work — filter bar + card matrix
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .filter-bar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-end;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
  }

  .filters {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem 1.25rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .filter {
    background: none;
    border: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 0;
    padding: 0.4rem 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: var(--ink-faint);
    transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease;
  }

  .filter:hover { color: var(--ink); }

  .filter[aria-pressed="true"] {
    color: var(--primary);
    border-bottom-color: var(--primary);
  }

  .filters.has-indicator .filter[aria-pressed="true"] { border-bottom-color: transparent; }

  .filter-indicator {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    height: 1px;
    width: 0;
    background: var(--primary);
    transform-origin: left center;
    transition: transform 200ms ease, width 200ms ease;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .filters.has-indicator .filter-indicator { display: block; }

  .filter-count {
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    white-space: nowrap;
    padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
  }

  .work-grid {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
    gap: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
    --mx: -9999px;
    --my: -9999px;
  }

  .card {
    position: relative;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding: 1.25rem;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    align-content: start;
    min-width: 0;
    transition: background-color 120ms ease;
  }

  .card:hover,
  .card:focus-within { background: var(--surface); }

  /* Spotlight ring — a primary glow revealed only through the borders */
  @supports ((mask-composite: exclude) or (-webkit-mask-composite: xor)) {
    .work-grid.has-spotlight .card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: -1px;
      left: -1px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;

        <div class="prose">
          <p>I sit behind the athlete-facing units — athletic medicine, strength and conditioning, nutrition, mental health — and build the measurement, analysis, and education layer they run on. My job is not to hand anyone a number. It is to make the next decision easier to make and harder to get wrong.</p>
          <p>The default move in my field is to collect more data and see what it says. I start earlier than that. Is the infrastructure in place? Is the right question being asked? Do we know what data would actually answer it? Skip those three and you get a dashboard nobody opens.</p>
          <p>Return to play is the clearest case. Common practice is to watch an asymmetry number until it crosses a line — twenty percent down to nineteen, cleared to go. The better question is which metrics matter for this athlete in this sport, and whether pre-injury performance has been restored, not whether an arbitrary threshold was crossed.</p>

      --ink: #E9EBE7;
      --ink-soft: #9CA6A7;
      --ink-faint: #6F7A7B;
      --rule: #27312F;
      --primary: #5CBCC6;
      --primary-soft: #5CBCC622;
      --signal: #E17E5B;
      --focus: #5CBCC6;
      --grid: #5CBCC618;
      --grid-strong: #5CBCC62E;
      --glow: #E17E5B;
      --glow-strength: 10;
      --bracket: #5CBCC666;
    }
  }

  :root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --ground: #0D1214;
    --surface: #151C1E;
    --surface-2: #1D2628;
    --ink: #E9EBE7;
    --ink-soft: #9CA6A7;
    --ink-faint: #6F7A7B;
    --rule: #27312F;
    --primary: #5CBCC6;
    --primary-soft: #5CBCC622;
    --signal: #E17E5B;
    --focus: #5CBCC6;
    --grid: #5CBCC618;
    --grid-strong: #5CBCC62E;
    --glow: #E17E5B;
    --glow-strength: 10;
    --bracket: #5CBCC666;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Base
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

  html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  }

  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--ground);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: clip;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  }

  [hidden] { display: none !important; }

  a { color: var(--primary); }

  :focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  ::selection { background: var(--primary-soft); }

  h1, h2, h3 { text-wrap: balance; }

  .wrap {
    max-width: var(--wrap);
    margin-inline: auto;
    padding-inline: var(--pad);
  }

  /* Utility mono — eyebrows, rails, tags, labels, footer */
  .mono {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.09em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-faint);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* Display — expanded Archivo, the stamp of the page */
  .display {
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-variation-settings: "wdth" 118, "wght" 800;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .display-sm {
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-variation-settings: "wdth" 110, "wght" 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Atmosphere — graticule and cursor field sit behind all content
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .graticule {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    background-image:
      repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--grid-strong) 0 1px, transparent 1px 136px),
      repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--grid-strong) 0 1px, transparent 1px 136px),
      repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--grid) 0 1px, transparent 1px 34px),
      repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--grid) 0 1px, transparent 1px 34px);
    -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 75% at 50% 14%, #000 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 40%, transparent 100%);
    mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 75% at 50% 14%, #000 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 40%, transparent 100%);
  }

  .cursor-field {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    width: 520px;
    height: 520px;
    margin: -260px 0 0 -260px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--primary-soft) 0%, transparent 60%);
    opacity: 0.55;
    will-change: transform;
    transform: translate3d(-9999px, -9999px, 0);
  }

  @media (pointer: fine) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    .cursor-field { display: block; }
  }

  .site-header, main, .site-footer {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  /* HUD corner brackets — punctuation, not decoration everywhere */
  .hud { position: relative; }

  .hud::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1px;
    pointer-events: none;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket)),
      linear-gradient(var(--bracket), var(--bracket));
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: 12px 1px, 1px 12px, 12px 1px, 1px 12px, 12px 1px, 1px 12px, 12px 1px, 1px 12px;
    background-position: 0 0, 0 0, 100% 0, 100% 0, 0 100%, 0 100%, 100% 100%, 100% 100%;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Header
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .site-header {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 10;
    background: var(--ground);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }

  .site-header .wrap {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1rem;
    min-height: var(--header-h);
    padding-block: 0.4rem;
  }

  .progress {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    bottom: -1px;
    width: 100%;
    height: 2px;
    background: var(--signal);
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: left center;
    will-change: transform;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .brand {
    color: var(--ink);
    text-decoration: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .brand:hover { color: var(--primary); }

  .nav {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: clamp(0.6rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
  }

  .nav a {
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    text-decoration: none;
    padding: 0.25rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease;
  }

  .nav a:hover,
  .nav a.is-active {
    color: var(--ink);
    border-bottom-color: var(--primary);
  }

  .clock {
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5em;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .clock { display: inline-flex; }
  }

  .clock-dot {
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--signal);
    animation: clock-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes clock-pulse {
    0%   { opacity: 1; }
    50%  { opacity: 0.25; }
    100% { opacity: 1; }
  }

  .theme-toggle {
    width: 2rem;
    height: 2rem;
    padding: 0;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    border: 1px solid var(--rule);
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: color 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease;
  }

  .theme-toggle:hover {
    color: var(--ink);
    background: var(--surface-2);
  }

  .theme-toggle svg {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    display: block;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Hero
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .hero {
    padding-block: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.25rem) clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
    display: grid;
    gap: clamp(1rem, 2.2vw, 1.4rem);
  }

  .hero-eyebrow {
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  .hero-name {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 9vw, 6.2rem);
    line-height: 0.9;
  }

  .hero-name span { display: block; }

  .hero-lead {
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 60ch;
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  .hero-title {
    text-wrap: balance;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }

  .trace-wrap {
    margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
  }

  /* The console panel around the canvas */
  .trace-panel {
    border: 1px solid var(--rule);
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: var(--surface);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 55%, transparent);
  }

  .trace-panel:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  .trace-caption {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.15rem 1.25rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .trace-stage {
    position: relative;
  }

  .trace {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 180px;
    touch-action: none;
    cursor: ew-resize;
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .trace { height: 224px; }
  }

  /* Live readout — DOM, decorative, driven by the playhead */
  .readout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto auto auto;
    gap: 0.2rem 1.25rem;
    padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .readout > div {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.6em;
    white-space: nowrap;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .readout-label { color: var(--ink-faint); }

  .readout-value {
    color: var(--ink);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .readout {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0.5rem;
      right: 0.5rem;
      grid-template-columns: auto auto;
      gap: 0.15rem 0.6rem;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.55rem;
      border: 0;
      background: var(--surface);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 80%, transparent);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }
    .readout > div { display: contents; }
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Instrument strip
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .stats {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    background: var(--surface);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 55%, transparent);
  }

  .stats-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .stats-row { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  }

  .stat {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.9rem 1rem 0.9rem 0;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .stat + .stat {
    border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding-left: 1rem;
  }

  @media (max-width: 699px) {
    .stat:nth-child(3) { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }
    .stat:nth-child(n + 3) { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
  }

  .stat-num {
    font-size: 1.6rem;
    line-height: 1;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  .stat-label {
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Sections — rail + body
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .section {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding-block: calc(var(--rhythm) / 2);
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.25rem clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
    scroll-margin-top: var(--header-h);
  }

  .rail { align-self: start; }

  @media (min-width: 1000px) {
    .section { grid-template-columns: 180px minmax(0, 1fr); }
    .rail {
      position: sticky;
      top: calc(var(--header-h) + 1.5rem);
    }
  }

  .section-body {
    min-width: 0;
    display: grid;
    gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
  }

  .section-heading {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.1rem);
    line-height: 1.05;
  }

  .prose {
    max-width: 66ch;
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.1em;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .prose p { margin: 0; }

  .lead {
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 66ch;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Method — flow rail + four numbered rows
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .flow {
    display: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: 64px;
    overflow: visible;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.09em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .flow { display: block; }
  }

  .flow-line { stroke: var(--rule); stroke-width: 1; }

  .flow-node circle {
    fill: var(--ground);
    stroke: var(--rule);
    stroke-width: 1;
    transition: stroke 220ms ease, fill 220ms ease;
  }

  .flow-node text {
    fill: var(--ink-faint);
    transition: fill 220ms ease;
  }

  .flow-node.is-lit circle {
    stroke: var(--signal);
    fill: var(--signal);
  }

  .flow-node.is-lit text { fill: var(--ink); }

  .flow-pulse {
    transform-box: view-box;
    transform: translateX(12.5%);
    will-change: transform;
  }

  .flow-pulse.is-jumping { transition: transform 220ms ease; }

  .flow-pulse circle {
    fill: var(--signal);
    stroke: none;
  }

  .steps {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }

  .step {
    position: relative;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding: 1.25rem 0 1.25rem 1rem;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 3.25rem minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 0.4rem 1rem;
    align-items: baseline;
  }

  .step::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 2px;
    background: var(--signal);
    transform: scaleY(0);
    transform-origin: top center;
    transition: transform 180ms ease;
  }

  .step:hover::before,
  .step:focus-visible::before,
  .step.is-held::before { transform: scaleY(1); }

  .step-num {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    transition: color 180ms ease;
  }

  .step:hover .step-num,
  .step:focus-visible .step-num,
  .step.is-held .step-num { color: var(--signal); }

  .step-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    line-height: 1.25;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }

  .step-text {
    margin: 0;
    grid-column: 2;
    max-width: 60ch;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .step { grid-template-columns: 3.25rem 15rem minmax(0, 1fr); }
    .step-text { grid-column: auto; }
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Work — filter bar + card matrix
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .filter-bar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-end;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
  }

  .filters {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem 1.25rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .filter {
    background: none;
    border: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 0;
    padding: 0.4rem 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: var(--ink-faint);
    transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease;
  }

  .filter:hover { color: var(--ink); }

  .filter[aria-pressed="true"] {
    color: var(--primary);
    border-bottom-color: var(--primary);
  }

  .filters.has-indicator .filter[aria-pressed="true"] { border-bottom-color: transparent; }

  .filter-indicator {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    height: 1px;
    width: 0;
    background: var(--primary);
    transform-origin: left center;
    transition: transform 200ms ease, width 200ms ease;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .filters.has-indicator .filter-indicator { display: block; }

  .filter-count {
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    white-space: nowrap;
    padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
  }

  .work-grid {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
    gap: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
    --mx: -9999px;
    --my: -9999px;
  }

  .card {
    position: relative;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding: 1.25rem;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    align-content: start;
    min-width: 0;
    transition: background-color 120ms ease;
  }

  .card:hover,
  .card:focus-within { background: var(--surface); }

  /* Spotlight ring — a primary glow revealed only through the borders */
  @supports ((mask-composite: exclude) or (-webkit-mask-composite: xor)) {
    .work-grid.has-spotlight .card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: -1px;
      left: -1px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      padding: 1px;
      pointer-events: none;
      background: radial-gradient(240px circle at calc(var(--mx) - var(--cx, 0px)) calc(var(--my) - var(--cy, 0px)), var(--primary) 0%, transparent 70%);
      -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
      -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
      mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
      mask-composite: exclude;
      opacity: 0.75;
    }
  }

  /* Corner brackets on hover only */
  .card::after {
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 180ms ease;
  }

  .card:hover::after,
  .card:focus-within::after { opacity: 1; }

  /* Scan line — a single signal hairline sweeping the card once */
  .scan {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    top: 0;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--signal);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .card:hover .scan,
  .card:focus-within .scan {
    animation: scan-sweep 250ms linear 1;
  }

  @keyframes scan-sweep {
    0%   { top: 0; opacity: 0.9; }
    100% { top: calc(100% - 1px); opacity: 0.9; }
  }

  .card.is-settling {
    animation: card-settle 120ms ease-out 1;
  }

  @keyframes card-settle {
    from { opacity: 0.4; transform: translateY(2px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  }

  .card-meta {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
  }

  .lane-mark {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6em;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .glyph {
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    flex: none;
    color: var(--ink-faint);
    transition: color 150ms ease;
  }

  .card:hover .glyph,
  .card:focus-within .glyph { color: var(--primary); }

  .stage { white-space: nowrap; }

  .stage::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--primary);
    margin-right: 0.5em;
    vertical-align: middle;
    position: relative;
    top: -1px;
  }

  .stage[data-stage="SHIPPED"]::before { background: var(--signal); }

  .card:hover .stage::before,
  .card:focus-within .stage::before {
    animation: dot-pulse 600ms ease-out 1;
  }

  @keyframes dot-pulse {
    0%   { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
    40%  { transform: scale(1.9); opacity: 0.55; }
    100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  }

  .card-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-variation-settings: "wdth" 108, "wght" 700;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }

  .card-desc {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Capabilities — definition list of chips
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .caps {
    margin: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }

  .caps > div {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    padding-block: 1.1rem;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.6rem 1.5rem;
  }

  .caps dt { padding-top: 0.35rem; }

  .caps dd {
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  @media (min-width: 700px) {
    .caps > div { grid-template-columns: 180px minmax(0, 1fr); }
  }

  .chip {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 0.66rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    border: 1px solid var(--rule);
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.55rem;
    max-width: 100%;
    transition: border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease;
    transition-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 40ms);
  }

  .chip:first-child { border-color: var(--primary); }

  .caps dd.is-lit .chip {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  .chip:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    color: var(--ink);
    transition-delay: 0ms;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Principles — deliberately quiet
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .principles {
    position: relative;
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 0 0 1.25rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  }

  .principles::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 1px;
    background: var(--rule);
    transform: scaleY(0);
    transform-origin: top center;

      <div class="rail mono">01 / Approach</div>
      <div class="section-body">
        <h2 class="section-heading display-sm" id="approach-heading">The question comes first</h2>
        <div class="prose">
          <p>I sit behind the athlete-facing units — athletic medicine, strength and conditioning, nutrition, mental health — and build the measurement, analysis, and education layer they run on. My job is not to hand anyone a number. It is to make the next decision easier to make and harder to get wrong.</p>
          <p>The default move in my field is to collect more data and see what it says. I start earlier than that. Is the infrastructure in place? Is the right question being asked? Do we know what data would actually answer it? Skip those three and you get a dashboard nobody opens.</p>
          <p>Return to play is the clearest case. Common practice is to watch an asymmetry number until it crosses a line — twenty percent down to nineteen, cleared to go. The better question is which metrics matter for this athlete in this sport, and whether pre-injury performance has been restored, not whether an arbitrary threshold was crossed.</p>
        </div>

<script>

  }

    syncToggle();
    refreshTokens();
    canvasDirty = true;

  }

  toggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
    root.dataset.theme = effectiveTheme() === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';

  });

  if (typeof MutationObserver === 'function') {
    new MutationObserver(onThemeChanged).observe(root, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-theme'] });
  }

  refreshTokens();
  syncToggle();

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------
     Header — scroll progress, active section, live clock
     ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var progressBar = document.getElementById('progress');

    scrollDirty = true;

  }, { passive: true });

  var navLinks = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.nav a[data-section]'));
  if (hasIO) {
    var sectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        var id = entry.target.id;
        navLinks.forEach(function (link) {
          if (link.getAttribute('data-section') !== id) { return; }
          if (entry.isIntersecting) { link.classList.add('is-active'); }
          else { link.classList.remove('is-active'); }

      var target = document.getElementById(link.getAttribute('data-section'));
      if (target) { sectionObserver.observe(target); }

  }

  var clockTime = document.getElementById('clock-time');
  function tickClock() {

  }
  tickClock();
  window.setInterval(tickClock, 1000);

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------

     ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var cursorField = document.getElementById('cursor-field');
  var cursorOn = mqFine.matches && !reduced();
  var cursorTarget = null;
  var cursorPos = { x: -9999, y: -9999 };

  if (cursorOn) {

    });
  }

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------
     Instrument strip — count up from zero, hold the true values
     ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var statNums = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.stat-num[data-count]'));
  var countStart = null;
  var COUNT_MS = 900;

  if (statNums.length && !reduced() && hasRAF) {
    statNums.forEach(function (el) { el.textContent = pad2(0); });
    consumers.push(function (now) {
      if (countStart === null) { countStart = now; }
      var k = clamp01((now - countStart) / COUNT_MS);
      var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3);
      statNums.forEach(function (el) {
        var target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-count'), 10) || 0;
        el.textContent = pad2(Math.round(target * eased));
      });
      return k < 1;
    });
  }

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------
     Hero trace — countermovement jump ground-reaction force.
     Force is a function of normalised time (0..1) in multiples of
     bodyweight through a monotone cubic (Fritsch–Carlson), so flat
     runs stay flat and nothing overshoots below the floor.
     ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var canvas = document.getElementById('trace');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var panel = document.getElementById('trace-panel');
  var roPhase = document.getElementById('ro-phase');
  var roForce = document.getElementById('ro-force');
  var roTime = document.getElementById('ro-time');

  var CONTROL = [
    [0.000, 1.00], [0.080, 1.00],                 // quiet standing at bodyweight
    [0.110, 0.97], [0.150, 0.78], [0.190, 0.52],  // unweighting
    [0.225, 0.44], [0.260, 0.62], [0.285, 1.00],  // trough, back through BW
    [0.310, 1.48], [0.335, 1.85], [0.360, 1.98],  // braking peak
    [0.385, 1.90], [0.410, 2.05], [0.440, 2.25],  // into propulsion
    [0.465, 2.30], [0.490, 2.18], [0.515, 1.85],  // propulsion peak, broad
    [0.540, 1.15], [0.555, 0.45], [0.565, 0.00],  // takeoff
    [0.650, 0.00], [0.735, 0.00],                 // flight
    [0.742, 0.90], [0.752, 3.60], [0.762, 2.20],  // landing spike
    [0.780, 0.75], [0.800, 0.62], [0.825, 1.35],  // settle
    [0.850, 0.85], [0.885, 1.14], [0.920, 0.94],
    [0.955, 1.03], [1.000, 1.00]
  ];

  var PHASES = [
    { label: 'UNWEIGHT',   a: 0.100, b: 0.285 },
    { label: 'BRAKING',    a: 0.285, b: 0.390 },
    { label: 'PROPULSION', a: 0.390, b: 0.565 },
    { label: 'FLIGHT',     a: 0.565, b: 0.735 },
    { label: 'LANDING',    a: 0.735, b: 1.000 }
  ];

  var MAX_V = 3.9;            // vertical scale, multiples of bodyweight
  var DRAW_MS = 1600;         // stroke draw-in
  var LOOP_MS = 7000;         // playhead sweep
  var TRACE_SECONDS = 1.4;    // plausible trace duration for the T readout
  var PEAK_T = 0.465;         // propulsion peak, the reduced-motion park position
  var PAD_L = 36, PAD_R = 8, PAD_T = 12;

  function monotoneCubic(points) {
    var n = points.length, xs = [], ys = [], d = [], m = new Array(n), i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { xs.push(points[i][0]); ys.push(points[i][1]); }
    for (i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) { d.push((ys[i + 1] - ys[i]) / (xs[i + 1] - xs[i])); }
    m[0] = d[0];
    m[n - 1] = d[n - 2];
    for (i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) { m[i] = (d[i - 1] * d[i] <= 0) ? 0 : (d[i - 1] + d[i]) / 2; }
    for (i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
      if (d[i] === 0) { m[i] = 0; m[i + 1] = 0; continue; }
      var a = m[i] / d[i], b = m[i + 1] / d[i], s = a * a + b * b;
      if (s > 9) {
        var tau = 3 / Math.sqrt(s);
        m[i] = tau * a * d[i];
        m[i + 1] = tau * b * d[i];
      }
    }
    return function (x) {
      if (x <= xs[0]) { return ys[0]; }
      if (x >= xs[n - 1]) { return ys[n - 1]; }
      var lo = 0, hi = n - 1;
      while (hi - lo > 1) {
        var mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
        if (xs[mid] <= x) { lo = mid; } else { hi = mid; }

  var force = monotoneCubic(CONTROL);

  function phaseName(t) {

    if (t < 0.390) { return 'BRAKING'; }
    if (t < 0.565) { return 'PROPULSION'; }
    if (t < 0.735) { return 'FLIGHT'; }

    var twoRows = PHASES.some(function (ph, i) { return labelWidths[i] > (ph.b - ph.a) * pw - 8; });
    var rowH = fontPx + 5;
    var labelGap = 10;
    var bottomPad = labelGap + rowH * (twoRows ? 2 : 1) + 2;

    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = rule;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(PAD_L, axisY + 0.5);
    ctx.lineTo(W - PAD_R, axisY + 0.5);

    PHASES.forEach(function (ph) { boundaries.push(ph.b); });

      ctx.moveTo(x, axisY + 1);
      ctx.lineTo(x, axisY + 6);
    });

    ctx.lineTo(W - PAD_R, bwY);

Done. The v2 rewrite is in place, not published, not run.

**Path:** `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/Website/personal/index.html` (~2,500 lines, 89 KB; same skeleton: `<title>`, one Google Fonts link, `<style>`, markup, `<script>`)

**What changed**

- **Tokens:** `--grid`, `--grid-strong`, `--glow`, `--glow-strength`, `--bracket` added to bare `:root` and redefined in both dark blocks (16 tokens, each defined exactly three times).
- **Atmosphere:** fixed graticule (34px cells, every 4th line strong, radial mask strongest behind the hero); cursor field on fine pointers only (`--primary-soft` at 0.55 opacity, lerp 0.08); `.hud` corner brackets on the hero panel, contact panel, and cards on hover only.
- **Header:** 2px `--signal` scroll-progress bar (`scaleX`, passive scroll listener feeding the loop), IntersectionObserver active-section nav, live `HH:MM:SS` clock with a pulsing dot (hidden under 700px, dot static under reduced motion).
- **Hero console:** panel with caption strip, in-canvas graticule and `0 / 1×BW / 2×BW / 3×BW` axis labels, dashed BW baseline kept, dark-only `shadowBlur` glow on the curve stroke, 1.6s draw-in then a 7s looping playhead (primary line, signal dot, axis tick), live PHASE / FORCE / T readout. Scrub by mouse hover/drag, touch (`touch-action: none`, pointer capture), and keyboard (panel is `role="slider"`, arrows 2%, Home/End); pointer resumes the loop 1.2s after leave/up, keyboard holds until blur. Reduced motion draws the full curve instantly and parks the playhead at the propulsion peak with scrub still working.
- **Instrument strip:** 17 / 04 / 05 / 08 rendered in HTML, count up over 900ms (skipped under reduced motion).
- **Method:** inline-SVG flow rail with a 5s eased `--signal` pulse lighting each node; hovering or focusing a row (rows are `tabindex="0"`) jumps the pulse to that node and holds; rows get the scaling left bar and number colour shift.
- **Work matrix:** pointer-following border spotlight (`--mx/--my` on the grid, per-card `--cx/--cy`, masked ring, `@supports`-guarded, fine pointers only), five hand-drawn lane glyphs via a hidden `<symbol>` sprite, hover brackets + one-shot stage-dot pulse + 250ms scan line, sliding filter indicator, `SHOWING n / 17` count with `aria-live`, 120ms settle from visible on filter change.
- **Capabilities:** 26 mono chips, staggered light-up on entry (40ms apart) settling to first-chip-primary; hover lights a chip.
- **Principles:** only the left rule drawing down with a riding dot; forced to final state under reduced motion.
- **Contact/footer:** `.hud` contact panel, left-to-right `--signal` underline wipe on links, `SYSTEM NOMINAL` status with slow-pulsing primary dot.
- **Loop hygiene:** one `requestAnimationFrame` loop; consumers report whether they still need frames, the loop idles when nothing does and any event wakes it; stops on `document.hidden`; hero and rail gated by IntersectionObserver; tokens cached and refreshed on toggle click, system change, and host `data-theme` mutation; all observers and pointer APIs existence-checked.

**Deviations to know about**

- The in-panel readout moves inside the canvas panel at **800px**, not 640px: with the y-axis labels the landing spike lands ~2px from a top-right readout at a 700px viewport, so 800 is the narrowest width with clean clearance. Below 800 it is a single row beneath the canvas.
- Cards carry no `tabindex` (17 dead tab stops); `:focus-within` styles are wired if anything inside becomes focusable. Method rows are focusable.
- Readout uses `UNWEIGHTING` and a `QUIET STANCE` tail from t = 0.955; canvas ticks keep `UNWEIGHT` and `LANDING` to the end.
- Chips drop the trailing period of each list; all words unchanged.
- Hero fit at 1280x800 by arithmetic: roughly 775px to the bottom of the trace panel, so the coordinator's 180/224 canvas heights are kept unchanged.

content.text:
Done. v3 "Night Field" is in place, not published, not run.

**Path:** `/Users/kristinarash/DEV/Website/personal/index.html` (~2,820 lines, 98 KB)

**Your four checks**

1. **Tokens.** Bare `:root` holds all 19 dark tokens; `:root[data-theme="light"]` redefines the same 19 (grep: each name appears exactly twice, one `:root {` block, one light block). The `prefers-color-scheme` media query, the old `:root[data-theme="dark"]` block, and the `mqDark` listener are gone — zero hits for `prefers-color-scheme`, `data-theme="dark"`, or `mqDark` anywhere in the file. The JS token fallbacks now carry Night Field values; `--sky` joined the cache.
2. **First frame.** The only `opacity: 0` rules are the graticule fade-in `from` frame, the sweep's end frame, the card bracket/scan-line decorations from v2, and the Waco marker's fade-in `from` frame. The sweep is a fixed 2px line at z 20 that rests off-screen and travels over the page once; the graticule fades in beneath the type. All 17 cards, headings and prose are untouched.
3. **Reduced motion.** Global `animation: none` kills sweep, graticule fade, plate draw-in and marker fade; the outline's resting CSS is `stroke-dasharray: 506; stroke-dashoffset: 0`, so it is complete with JS off, under reduced motion, and before the observer fires. Rail gauges snap to full, the starfield stays static, scrub still works. I swapped `pathLength="1"` for the literal perimeter (506 user units, SVG rendered 1:1 at 160×150px) because Chromium ignores `pathLength` normalisation when `vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke` is set, which would have rendered the resting map dotted.
4. **Contrast** (WCAG ratios computed, not eyeballed): `--ink` 16.4:1; `--ink-soft` 6.96 on ground, 6.66 on surface. **`--ink-faint` lifted in both themes:** dark `#5E6B72 → #728189` (3.61 → 4.93 on ground, 4.71 on surface, still 1.41 below `--ink-soft` so the hierarchy holds); light `#77838A → #5F6C73` (3.10 → 4.31 / 4.86). `--signal` 9.3 and `--primary` 8.4 on ground; their luminance ratio to each other is 1.11 but they separate by hue (amber vs cyan). Focus ring is `--primary` at 8.4:1.

**Texas: shipped the outline.** The projected shape rendered with a clean rectangular panhandle notch, a sharp El Paso point, the Big Bend V, and a smooth concave Gulf sweep to the southern tip, with Waco landing at (112.7, 70.8) in central Texas. Crosshair arms 3–7 units each side with a 7px star centred on Waco.

**What changed**

- Header: 14px 1px-stroke star before the wordmark (use #1; wordmark rests `--ink-soft`, both go `--ink` on hover), `31.5493°N 97.1467°W` readout with a rule divider left of the clock (≥900px), header ground at 90% via `color-mix` so the horizon is felt through it, toggle defaults flipped so the no-JS state matches dark.
- Sky: 60 seeded 1px `--sky` dots (mulberry32, fixed seed, upper third thinning downward, 12–22%) on a fixed canvas under the graticule, five breathing 12–30% on 4–7s offset cycles inside the shared loop, hidden in daylight; 180px `--horizon` band at the page top; 420ms power-on sweep and graticule fade, CSS-only.
- Method rail pulse is now the 5px star (use #2); nodes stay circles.
- Section rails get a 1px `--rule` tick that fills with `--primary` as the section passes the viewport midline, driven from the existing scroll consumer.
- Contact: panel caption `CONTACT` / `LAT/LON — WGS 84`, then a nested `.hud` survey plate (wireframe outline, `--primary` crosshair, 7px star as use #3, `BASED IN — WACO, TEXAS` and the coordinates); the plain `Based in` row is gone.
- Hero caption is `FORCE PLATE · 1000 Hz · WACO, TX`; footer is four cells (`WACO, TX · 31.5493°N 97.1467°W` and `BUILD 2026.09` added), 2-column below 700px.
- Only new literals in visible text: the coordinates (three places), `WGS 84`, `WACO, TX`, `2026.09`.

**Deviations and notes for the design lead**

- Plate outline is stroked `--ink-faint` at 0.6 opacity (1.0 on hover) rather than `--rule`: `--rule #1B242C` on `#070A0E` is 1.26:1, which would make the map effectively invisible. This is the one place I overrode a specified token.
- That same 1.26:1 applies to every hairline, the card matrix borders and the gauge track. `--rule` is not in the §6 list so I left it; it is near-threshold and your call.
- `--glow-strength` held at 12 (the brief's fallback is 9); I cannot see whether it smears.
- The twinkle consumer keeps the RAF loop alive in dark mode (throttled to ~20fps), an exception to v2's hero-visibility pause.
- Viewers whose host stamps `data-theme="light"` get daylight; unstamped viewers on a light OS get dark, as specified.
- Carried from v2: in-panel readout from 800px, cards untabbable, readout `UNWEIGHTING` / `QUIET STANCE` tail.
